finalText:
The Diceret cell in the Iuvaret4 row is **Phaedrum4**. After I clicked that row's edit link, the URL was **https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/challenging_dom#edit**.

**How I identified the row:**
- I read the table's text and screenshot. The row whose first cell (the Lorem column) reads "Iuvaret4" is the fifth data row. It sits between the Iuvaret3 and Iuvaret5 rows.
- The same row has Apeirian4, Adipisci4, Definiebas4 and Consequuntur4 in its other cells. These match the row's number.
- I found the Diceret column from the table header, where it is the sixth column. In the Iuvaret4 row, that cell reads "Phaedrum4".
- I clicked the "edit" link in the Action column on that same row. In the screenshot it lines up with Iuvaret4 at about y≈479. After the click, that link showed as visited or focused.

The click only added the `#edit` fragment to the URL. The page didn't navigate anywhere else or show an edit form.
